title: Regions Bank Launches “Regions Extra: Welcome to the SEC” Video Podcast Featuring Four New SEC Head Football Coaches
summary: SEC Network personalities Peter Burns and Chris Doering host this new video podcast for fans of SEC football. Ahead of the 2026 SEC Football Kick Off Media Days, Regions Bank on Thursday announced the launch of “ Regions Extra: Welcome to the SEC ,” a video podcast series featuring exclusive interviews with four newly hired Southeastern Conference (SEC) head football coaches. The series gives college football fans an insider’s look at each coach’s personal journey, leadership philosophy and coaching career. Regions Bank is launching“Regions Extra: Welcome to the SEC,” a new video podcast series featuring exclusive interviews with four newly hired Southeastern Conference (SEC) head football coaches. Regions Bank is the official bank of the SEC. What is Regions Bank’s Connection to the SEC? Regions is the official bank of the Southeastern Conference , and Regions and the SEC work year-round to support financial wellness initiatives for student-athletes from a wide range of sports.
